from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        star = operator.Star(worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3,
            worker_prompts=["{problem}", "{problem}", "{problem}"],
            aggregator_prompt="Solve the decryption using the hint pair. Compare all candidate decodings carefully, prefer the one matching the full ciphertext length exactly, and output only the best plaintext candidate in uppercase with no explanation.\nProblem:\n{problem}\nCandidates:\n{worker_outputs}")
        draft = await star(problem)
        seq = operator.Sequential(llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_rounds=1, prompts=[prompt_custom.FORMAT_DECRYPT_FINAL])
        final = await seq(f"Problem:\n{problem}\nDraft plaintext candidate:\n{draft['response']}")
        return final['response'], {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }
